Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.description: Everything you need to know about how StareYou helps businesses build a stronger digital presence.

what.title: What does StareYou do?
what.content: StareYou builds custom websites for businesses, ecommerce brands, creatives, and personal brands. We focus on premium design, strong messaging, and conversion-focused experiences that help you attract clients and grow revenue.

ecommerce.title: Can you build ecommerce websites?
ecommerce.content: Yes. We design and build ecommerce websites that are visually polished, easy to shop, and structured to help customers convert. From product pages to storefront strategy, we handle the build with a sales-first approach.

timeline.title: How long does a website take to build?
timeline.content: Most projects take between 2 and 6 weeks depending on scope, pages, and complexity. We move quickly, but we also make sure the final site is polished, conversion-focused, and ready to represent your brand.

improve.title: Do you only build websites, or can you also improve existing ones?
improve.content: We do both. If you already have a website, we can redesign it, improve the user experience, refresh the messaging, and optimize it to better convert visitors into customers.

support.title: Do you offer support after launch?
support.content: Absolutely. We offer ongoing support and optimization so your site keeps performing as your business grows. That can include updates, improvements, SEO adjustments, and new landing page concepts.

Footer.description: We build premium websites for businesses, ecommerce brands, and personal brands that want to stand out online.
